title: 第九章一点都不可爱的凑弟弟新书求推荐票求收藏第十章王爸老爹你得支楞起来啊新书求推荐票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第九章一点都不可爱的凑弟弟！
【新书，求推荐票，求收藏】
事实证明，天大的奇遇也暂时不能改变作为碳基生命的本质。
忙碌了一晚上，又获得了各种奇遇，连“圣斗士”
都当上了的王璃，他是被生生饿醒的……
“好吧，虽然“圣斗士”
的修炼，对资源消耗能少到几乎喝西北风的程度，但我还只是一个刚刚感悟“第五感”
的圣斗士预备役而已，这多多少少还是要吃饭的……”
早上，迎着正道的阳光，王璃同学揉着肚子从自己床上爬了起来。
“妈！
早饭好了吗？！”
王璃大喊一声。
“早好了，你弟弟妹妹就都在桌上等着你呢！”
楼下传来王母依旧中气十足的回应声。
“哦，我这就下来啊。”
赶紧随便扒拉洗漱完，王璃走下楼，来了家里桌前面。
“早啊，小妹。”
王璃伸手熟练得在王璐璐头顶揉了揉，然后就在妹妹的非常开心的笑闹声里，就一屁股就坐到自己的椅子上。
“羞羞羞～”
小丫头王璐璐迎着王璃的笑，给王璃做了一个大大的可爱的鬼脸，肥嘟嘟的脸蛋都在晃动：“哥哥，我和弟弟都已经练了两个小时的武功了，你竟然才起床。”

“嘎嘎嘎……”
王璃表示自己不跟妹妹一般见识，一扭头，就看到旁边正在认真吃了“智多星儿童营养早餐”
，又冷着小脸蛋的弟弟王络。
“哦，我的柯罗诺斯啊，瞧瞧我看到了什么！
这不是我鱼唇的凑弟弟吗？你今天怎么能舍得见你家最爱你的大哥哥了？”
王璃伸手，大笑声中，一记爱的铁锤，直击了王络小朋友眼冒金花，深深感受到了自己大哥对自己的“关心”
“不，哥哥，妹妹她有一点说错了。
最近太阳升起的早，实际上我和妹妹已经练功两個半小时了。
哥，伱今天果然又懈怠了啊。
这样下去，哥你还怎么再在武道上攀登，还怎么考大学，还怎么入赘到元竹姐姐家，去当一名合格的，能直接歪嘴一乐的龙王？”
冷着小脸蛋的凑弟弟王络，果然还是那么不可爱，这么多能直插人肺管子的话，他竟然张嘴就来！
小小年纪，王璃都不知道他这个凑弟弟是怎么知道这么多的词汇量的。
还“歪嘴龙王”
呢，哥哥我现在看你就很有歪嘴龙王的资质！
也不知道为什么，王璃一直都觉得自己这凑弟弟比自己都长的像一个穿越者，只是一直苦于没有证据，只能无奈作罢。
不过，该说不说啊，在练习武道这件事上，王同学也是自知理亏。
毕竟在这个武道称雄，以武为尊，又因为古月闪耀，而导致数个异域世界相互重叠变得危险无比的新世界里，不论是几岁的孩子，他们事实上都已经失去能有睡懒觉的权利了。
武道，极其重天资，财侣法地缺一不可，修行又如逆水行舟，不进则退。
平常普通人家，财力不够，功法不行，又没有充足的元力，在天资能跟得上的情况下，自然只能以自我苦修，苦修，超过他人百倍、千倍的苦修来去抹平，和其他天之骄子们的差距了。
或者说越是平常普通人家，他家若是有武道天资聪颖的孩子，他们的家长就越是不允许孩子在起跑线上就落后了。

第九章一点都不可爱的凑弟弟！
【新书，求推荐票，求收藏】
而不巧的是，老王家虽然“农家乐”

Chapter 9 Minato’s brother is not cute at all!
[New book, please vote for recommendation, please collect]
Facts have proved that even great adventures cannot change the nature of carbon-based life for the time being.
After a busy night, I got various adventures, even the "Saint Seiya"
Wang Li, who had been fooled, woke up from hunger...
"Well, although "Saint Seiya"
With my practice, I can consume so little resources that I can almost drink the northwest wind, but I am still just a person who has just realized the "fifth sense"
He is just a reserve Saint Seiya, and he still needs to eat more or less..."
In the morning, facing the bright sunshine, classmate Wang Li got up from his bed, rubbing his belly.
"Mom!
Is breakfast ready? ! "
Wang Li shouted.
"Good morning, your brothers and sisters are all waiting for you at the table!"
The Queen Mother's still angry response came from downstairs.
"Oh, I'll come down right away."
After hurriedly washing up, Wang Li walked downstairs and came to the table at home.
"Morning, little sister."
Wang Li stretched out his hand and rubbed Wang Lulu's head skillfully, and then sat down on his chair amidst his sister's very happy laughter.
"Shame, shame, shame~"
The little girl Wang Lulu met Wang Li's smile and made a big cute face for Wang Li. Her plump face was shaking: "Brother, my brother and I have been practicing martial arts for two hours, and you just got up."
"Quack quack..."
Wang Li said that he was not as knowledgeable as his sister. When he turned his head, he saw that he was seriously eating the "Zhiduoxing Children's Nutritious Breakfast" next to him.
, and looked coldly at his little-faced brother Wang Luo.
"Oh, my Chronos, look what I see!
Isn't this my Yulun's younger brother? How can you be reluctant to see your eldest brother who loves you the most today? "
Wang Li stretched out his hand, and in the midst of laughter, a hammer of love hit Wang Luo. The child's eyes were filled with tears, and he deeply felt his elder brother's "care" for him.
"No, brother, sister, she said something wrong.
The sun has risen early recently, and my sister and I have actually been practicing for two and a half hours.
Brother, you are indeed slacking off again today.
If this continues, brother, how can you continue to climb the martial arts, how can you go to college, how can you marry into sister Yuanzhu's house and become a qualified Dragon King who can directly twist his mouth and have fun? "
The cold-faced little brother Wang Luo is still so unlovable. With so many words that can be inserted directly into a person's lungs, he actually opens his mouth and does it!
At such a young age, Wang Li didn't know how his little brother knew so much vocabulary.
Also "Crooked Mouth Dragon King"
Well, brother, I see now that you have the qualifications to be the Dragon King with a crooked mouth!
For some reason, Wang Li always felt that his younger brother looked like a time traveler than himself, but he had no choice but to give up because there was no evidence.
However, it should be said or not, when it comes to practicing martial arts, classmate Wang also knows that he is in the wrong.
After all, in this new world where martial arts reigns supreme, where martial arts is respected, and where the shining ancient moon makes several foreign worlds overlap and become extremely dangerous, children, no matter how old they are, have actually lost the right to sleep in.
In martial arts, talent is extremely important, and wealth, law, and earth are indispensable. Practice is like sailing against the current. If you don't advance, you will retreat.
Ordinary people don't have enough financial resources, poor martial arts, and not enough energy. If their talents can keep up, they can only use self-cultivation and hard work, which is hundreds or a thousand times more than others, to even out the gap between them and other talented people.
In other words, the more ordinary an ordinary family has children who are talented in martial arts, the more their parents will not allow their children to fall behind at the starting line.
